title: Prompt: explain an Intune error to the help desk
problem: Help desk staff don't understand Intune error codes.
steps: Open Microsoft Copilot Chat (formerly Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat) or your approved AI tool.
'Explain this Intune error to a level-1 help desk agent: [error text]. Give likely causes, safe first steps, and when to escalate. Do not invent error codes; say if you are unsure.'
Review the output critically and verify facts against official documentation.
pitfalls: Never paste secrets, tenant IDs or personal data into tools not approved for that data.
AI output can be wrong — treat it as a draft.
done_when: The help-desk explanation has been checked against Microsoft documentation and saved in your knowledge base.
